title: MIA 2022 Shared Task: Evaluating Cross-lingual Open-Retrieval Question Answering for 16 Diverse Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual open-retrieval QA systems (using F1 and Exact Match metrics) across 16 typologically diverse languages, and analyzing the correlation between a model's performance in a target language and the degree of answer overlap with its English counterparts to measure the English-centric bias of retrieval and generative models.

Comparing model performance on questions natively written by target language speakers (XOR-TyDi QA) versus human-translated questions originally sourced from English (MKQA) to measure the gap in cultural generalization and identify Western/American-centric biases in information-seeking datasets.
